realm.name: SAMPLE_MANAGER
realm.description: Can modify documents (UMA write permission, with tenant context)

realm.name: SAMPLE_USER
realm.description: Any signed-in user of the sample applications

clients.name: Trust sample API
clients.description: JWT resource server + UMA resource server - trust-sample-api, http://localhost:9082. Exchanges the user's token (RFC 8693) and calls with its own identity (client_credentials) towards trust-sample-downstream-api.

policies.name: Tenant A context policy
policies.description: Built-in Regex policy on the claim_token context sent by Trust: grants only when tenant = tenant-a

clients.name: Trust sample downstream API
clients.description: Opaque-token resource server (RFC 7662 introspection) - trust-sample-downstream-api, http://localhost:9083. Its secret authenticates introspection calls only.

clientScopes.name: acr
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add acr (authentication context class reference) to the token

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: sample.system
clientScopes.description: Machine-to-machine access to trust-sample-downstream-api system endpoints (client_credentials only)

clientScopes.name: organization
clientScopes.description: Additional claims about the organization a subject belongs to

clientScopes.name: basic
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add all basic claims to the token

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token

clientScopes.name: service_account
clientScopes.description: Specific scope for a client enabled for service accounts
